notes.title: Mod Mage Mike - Now for Mac!
notes.notes: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]As part of my goal to bring this game to as many players as possible, I’m happy to announce that Mod Mage Mike is now available on Mac![/p][p][/p][p]/Albin[/p]

notes.title: Mod Mage Mike 1.0.2 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Here comes a small quality-of-life update. Enjoy!
Also don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/bKw4FTbx]Discord[/url] for more updates.

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Deactivate Spell Tower when open the Spell Editor, removing the need to double-click to shoot again
[*] Disconnect connections by dragging over them, replacing double click
[*] Highlight the help button when a new node is introduced
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixes update 1.0.1

Mouse can drag outside knobs when changing value
Add depth to node graphics
Bigger hitboxes on node arrow buttons
Fix toggles on nodes not turning gray when disabled

notes.title: Mod Mage Mike release June 23!
notes.notes: [p]Happy to announce Mod Mage Mike will be released shortly after Steam Next Fest! (Check out the demo if you haven't already) release date is June 23.[/p][p][/p][p]The game has been almost four years in the making so we are really looking forward to finally make you be able to play it![/p][p][/p][p]/Albin[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024028/f651660f02a1a24d6c731686eab6b49160657ad9.png"][/img][/p]
